subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session discard that session’s queued followup and lane work through the new public `clearQueued` parameter?
rationale: The source and proof support session-scoped cancellation, but whether stop should destructively suppress already queued work is a persistent protocol and user-experience contract that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
options.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` as the intended destructive-stop behavior for selected non-global channel sessions and retain the documented compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Cancel active work only
options.body: Retain session-scoped cancellation but omit queue clearing so queued successor work follows the prior behavior.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Defer this public protocol expansion until maintainers choose the long-term session cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
recommendation.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` as the intended destructive-stop behavior for selected non-global channel sessions and retain the documented compatibility boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest direct context from the current and preceding related implementation proposals, although current-main ownership remains unverified.
